featured_reviews.name: JAGRUTI PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience till date.

I have never faced such unprofessional behaviour anywhere else.

While booking my appointment, I was charged ₹5,000 in advance a day prior, with the explanation that this would include a hair expert consultation, followed by treatment, haircut, and root touch-up/hair colour. I was also told that if I got late, the amount would not be refunded, which already felt excessive.

I reached exactly on time. I first consulted the hair expert, who explained things well and addressed my concerns. However, when I confirmed about my haircut, the owner/head, Hardik Malde, intervened and repeated the same explanations already given by multiple people. He then stated that it wouldn’t be possible within the time and that an experienced hair expert would not be available for my haircut—despite this being clearly promised during booking.

When I refused to get my haircut done by an inexperienced person and reminded them of the commitment made on call, his behaviour turned rude and aggressive. At one point, I was told to “just do the haircut and go home,” which was shocking and highly unprofessional.

My main concerns were never properly understood or addressed. During the root touch-up, when I mentioned I liked the colour and would prefer highlights done by an experienced expert, I was openly told not to take membership and not to come back again. I was insulted in front of other clients and staff, which was extremely disrespectful.

All I wanted was genuine guidance—a subtle, classy look with volume for frontal thinning and a soft hair colour to hide greys. Instead, I received a basic trim with no real styling or expert input.

I am a doctor myself and treat my patients with respect and patience, answering all their queries regardless of how small they may seem. Unfortunately, the same basic courtesy was completely missing here.

Overpriced, overhyped, and extremely unprofessional management with extremely manner less,rude,aggressive,disrespectful and egoistic owner.
Would strongly recommend choosing places where clients are treated with respect and their concerns are genuinely heard.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Jagruti, firstly you had a history of 3 no-shows - You booked an appointment with us three times and did not come to the salon wasting salon and the hairdresser's time (approx 12 hours) hence you were asked to pay a deposit of Rs. 5000 in advance which was not refundable in case of 4th no show. Secondly, You had booked an appointment for Haircut & Touchup only on the call and we had clearly clarified that haircut will be done by Hair Expert but the touchup will be done by a Hair Magician (NOT Inexperienced. Hair Magicians have 5+ years of experience in hair) to which you agreed. Thirdly, after coming to the salon you changed your service 3 times (that too after the color service had started) hampering our schedule for the day. Inspite of that we were courteous & kind enough to accomodate you and provided you with a Hair Magician instead of a Hair Expert for those services which you refused to take. Clearly, the problem wasn’t the salon… it was the lack of clarity at your end.
